## Personality

Conseil is remarkably calm, phlegmatic, and self-possessed, maintaining an imperturbable coolness and even temper regardless of the situation. Highly devoted to his master, he is also extremely ceremonious by nature. Driven by curiosity, he possesses a skill for classifying fish.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P6](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P22](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P25](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), +6 more_

## History

Conseil joined his master, Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) to hunt a mysterious sea monster, eventually setting sail onto the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) and searching the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean. After being thrown overboard during an encounter with the target, Conseil rescued [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and kept them afloat until they found [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) atop a metallic submarine, which they were subsequently pulled into by masked men. They were imprisoned by Captain Nemo, who informed them that they would remain captives on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) forever. While aboard, Conseil accompanied [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) on multiple underwater excursions, including a hunting trip in the forests of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo) Island and a visit to a coral cemetery to bury a fallen crewman. During a land excursion to the island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa), Conseil gathered wild foods and game with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) before fleeing an attack by [Papuan](../codex/places.md#papua) islanders. He later explored the pearl banks of [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon), gathered supplies inside an extinct underwater volcano, and visited the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole) after the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigated beneath the ice barrier. When the vessel became trapped in an iceberg, Conseil risked his life by giving his last saved air to [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) as they suffocated before the ship managed to break free. After witnessing the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) sink a warship and enduring Captain Nemo's growing madness, Conseil joined [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) in a daring escape using a small boat, surviving the Norwegian maelstrom to wake up safely in the Lofoten Isles.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P27](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P43](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P6](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P47](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0047), +60 more_

>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P37](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0037)

> “I can picture it perfectly,” said Conseil. “But, sir, will you tell me why the Great Architect has suspended operations, and how it is that the furnace is replaced by the quiet waters of the lake?”
>
> — Conseil — [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P33](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0033)

> “Well,” said Conseil, with the most serious air in the world, “I remember perfectly to have seen a large vessel drawn under the waves by an octopus’s arm.”
>

## Relationships

### [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aronnax--conseil.md)

Conseil is the devoted servant of Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), obediently packing their belongings when [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) decides to join the expedition against the sea monster. Their bond deepens into one of mutual support and shared captivity after both are taken aboard the mysterious [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), where they remain traveling companions under Captain Nemo's captivity.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P27](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0027), +17 more_

### [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--ned-land.md)

Conseil and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) first crossed paths during the search for the sea monster aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln). After Conseil rescued [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) from drowning, the pair found [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) standing atop the metallic surface of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), bringing them all together. Since then, the two have become close friends and cabin mates, navigating their shared imprisonment aboard the submarine side by side.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P13](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0013), +35 more_
